requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

728-4550-5567-8298--112.easyPrerequisites: You have two or more cards in hand.
728-4550-5567-8298--112.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the Zombie, whose power should have been altered from its base power.
When the Zombie dies, Jason Bright triggers, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

671-1339-8192.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
671-1339-8192.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters, Daxos triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Niv-Mizzet triggers, causing you to pay 1 life to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

2438-5254-5902.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature with power 4 or greater.
2438-5254-5902.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the creature with power 4 or greater.
When the creature dies, Warbeast of Gorgoroth triggers, creating a 0/0 Army creature token if you don't control one, then putting four +1/+1 counters on an Army you control.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Carrion Feeder
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

678-5670-6794--52.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
678-5670-6794--52.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
When the creature dies, Susurian Voidborn and Enduring Renewal trigger.
Resolve the Susurian Voidborn trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

955-1991-3259.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
955-1991-3259.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Tana, triggering Breath of Fury and Tana.
Resolve the Tana trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

360-4399-4518-5998.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Grand Arbiter Augustin IV.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Soul Warden triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Soul Warden trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Soul Warden trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
360-4399-4518-5998.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-745-1619-6913.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-745-1619-6913.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Chameleon and Mirrorhall Mimic each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Chameleon trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Mirrorhall Mimic trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-745-1619-6913.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

2997-3558-3652-6516.easyPrerequisites:
It is an opponent's turn.
One of the {0}-cost creatures must be in your hand, with the other being on the battlefield.
2997-3558-3652-6516.description:
During an opponent's turn, cast the {0}-cost creature in your hand by paying {0}.
Glen Elendra Pranksters triggers, returning the other {0}-cost creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the spell from step 1.
Repeat.

5477-6968-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
5477-6968-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
5477-6968-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

2438-4681-6542-7747.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing Giant-Sized Flying Ant, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Giant-Sized Flying Ant from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Giant-Sized Flying Ant enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
Repeat.

186-7426-7628-7737.easyPrerequisites: There's a removable +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
186-7426-7628-7737.description:
Activate Ray Fillet by paying {1} due to Heartstone and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, causing you to draw a card.
Stark's Ingenuity triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
Berta triggers, adding {1}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

206-1563-3899-6753.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

4120-5641-7352.notablePrerequisites: Vigor has indestructible, protection from creatures or protection from red.
4120-5641-7352.description:
Cast Electric Seaweed by paying {2}{R}{R}.
When Electric Seaweed enters, it triggers.
Activate Electric Seaweed by tapping it, attempting to deal 1 damage to Basking Broodscale, which will instead put a +1/+1 counter on it due to Vigor.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
When the Eldrazi Spawn dies, Electric Seaweed triggers, dealing 1 damage to each non-Wall creature your opponents control. Each non-Wall creature you control (excluding Vigor) will not be dealt damage, and will instead have a +1/+1 counter put on it due to Vigor.
Repeat from step 4.

874-1170-1329-7296.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one creature.
874-1170-1329-7296.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Delif's Cone from your graveyard.
Cast Delif's Cone by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Delif's Cone by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

1402-2644-4763-7175.description:
Cast Diamond Lion by paying {2}.
When Diamond Lion enters, Sai of the Shinobi triggers, attaching itself to Diamond Lion.
Activate Diamond Lion by tapping it, sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding three mana of any color.
When Diamond Lion dies, Koll triggers, returning Diamond Lion from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

5220-5256-6537-6900.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Tarpan.
When Tarpan dies, it and Mortuary triggers.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Tarpan from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Tarpan trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Cast Tarpan from the top of your library by paying 1 life due to Gwenom.
Repeat.

339-677-4785-5147.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1680-4508-5880-6753.description:
Activate Magmaw by paying {1} and sacrificing another nonland permanent, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1563-1849-2457-6753.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

3586-4222-5115.description:
Activate Magus Lucea Kane by tapping it, adding {2} and causing you to copy the next ability you activate or spell you cast that has {X} in its cost.
Activate Gemstone Array's first ability by paying {2}, putting a charge counter on it.
Activate Gemstone Array's second ability by removing a charge counter from it, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Magus Lucea Kane.
Repeat.
Once you have a large number of delayed triggers, cast a spell or activate an ability with {X} in its cost to have Magus Lucea Kane copy that spell or ability infinitely.

2178-2438-3362-6542.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken Dragon with mana value 6.
2178-2438-3362-6542.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing a nontoken Dragon with mana value 6.
When the creature dies, Sidisi triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Resolve the Sidisi ability, returning Bladewing from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Bladewing enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning the Dragon with mana value 6 from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Bladewing.
When Bladewing dies, Sidisi triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

2058-2073-2921.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning Flayer Husk from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Flayer Husk enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 0/0 Phyrexian Germ creature token and attaching Flayer Husk to it.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Flayer Husk.
The Phyrexian Germ dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering Salvaging Station, untapping Salvaging Station.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

2084-3851.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two opponents.
2084-3851.description:
Declare Mirror-Mad Phantasm as an attacker.
Mirror-Mad Phantasm's myriad ability triggers, creating a token copy of itself tapped and attacking each other opponent.
Activate a Mirror-Mad Phantasm token by paying {1}{U}, causing you to shuffle it into your library, then reveal and mill your entire library due to not having a card named Mirror-Mad Phantasm in it.

1322-3204-4364-6188.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block and kill Aurelia.
Fear of Missing Out cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
Mysterious Limousine does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
One of Aurelia or Fear of Missing Out must be on the battlefield, with the other exiled by Mysterious Limousine.
1322-3204-4364-6188.description:
Declare either Aurelia or Fear of Missing Out and Mysterious Limousine as attackers.
Mysterious Limousine and either Aurelia or Fear of Missing Out trigger.
Resolve the Aurelia or Fear of Missing Out trigger, untapping Mysterious Limousine and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Mysterious Limousine trigger, exiling Aurelia or Fear of Missing Out from the battlefield, and then returning Aurelia or Fear of Missing Out from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

1479-3585-4826-5700-5701.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-3585-4826-5700-5701.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Greensleeves trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Greensleeves trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield untapped as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Greensleeves triggers.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Greensleeves trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Greensleeves triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

1881-4809-5220.description:
Cast Shifting Wall either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Shifting Wall enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Mortuary triggers, putting Shifting Wall on top of your library from your graveyard.
Repeat.

1242-2838-2979.notablePrerequisites: Patchwork Crawler does not have summoning sickness, and does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1242-2838-2979.description:
Activate Patchwork Crawler using Cinderhaze Wretch's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Activate Patchwork Crawler using Soul Diviner's ability by tapping it and removing a -1/-1 counter from it, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

132-3609-5115.notablePrerequisites: Myr Welder does not have summoning sickness.
132-3609-5115.description:
Activate Myr Welder using Gemstone Array's first ability by paying {2}, putting a charge counter on Myr Welder.
Repeat step 1 two additional times.
Activate Myr Welder using Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

3957-4702-5070.notablePrerequisites:
Famished Paladin does not have summoning sickness.
Splinter Twin attached to Famished Paladin.
3957-4702-5070.description:
Tap Famished Paladin to create a token copy of it with haste.
The token ETBs, triggering Angelic Chorus and gaining you 3 life.
All of your Famished Paladins trigger, untapping themselves.
Repeat for infinite creature tokens with haste.

2174-3525-3756.notablePrerequisites:
Juniper Order Druid does not have summoning sickness.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Juniper Order Druid.
2174-3525-3756.description:
Activate Izzet Boilerworks by tapping it, adding {U}{R}.
Activate Juniper Order Druid by tapping it, untapping Izzet Boilerworks.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Juniper Order Druid.
Repeat any number of times.
